summary: A docs folder with a document written in Windows line endings
description: What CRLF handling exists for. `docs/windows.md` is committed with \r\n and then has one more paragraph appended, also with \r\n, so the preview must read it as paragraphs and the diff must mark only the new one — not every line, which is what a carriage return read as content would do. The file is made by a commit, not by content/, because the fixture's content cannot hold the bytes.

write.docs/windows.md:
# Windows

A note saved by an editor on Windows.
It has two lines in this paragraph.

Second paragraph.

uncommitted.docs/windows.md: Third paragraph, added after the commit.
